payload.name: Expertise reversal effect
payload.fact: Instructional techniques that facilitate learning among early learners may not help and may even interfere with learning among more advanced learners.
payload.boundary: Applies to reading comprehension tasks with vocabulary definitions; depends on learner expertise.

provenance.title: Cognitive Load and Learner Expertise: Split-Attention and Redundancy Effects in Reading Comprehension Tasks With Vocabulary Definitions
provenance.quote_or_locus: For less experienced readers, the integrated format reduced split-attention effects for comprehension but induced redundancy effects for vocabulary learning. For more experienced readers, the integrated format induced redundancy effects and hampered performance in comprehension
